policy_findings.title: Password Authentication Disabled in Scoped Defaults (!authenticate)
policy_findings.description: Scoped Defaults for [ops] sets '!authenticate', disabling password prompts for all matching rules.

policy_findings.title: Passwordless Dangerous Sudo Binary allowed: less (command)
policy_findings.description: The user(s) [ops] can run '/usr/bin/less /var/log/syslog' via sudo as [root] without a password (NOPASSWD) with the 'command' capability. This enables immediate privilege escalation.
policy_findings.remediation: Remove this binary from sudoers or replace it with a tightly scoped wrapper script.
policy_findings.remediation_code:
# Enforce NOEXEC and explicit arguments, or replace with a dedicated wrapper script:
ops ALL = (root) PASSWD: NOEXEC: /usr/bin/less /var/log/syslog

policy_findings.title: Passwordless Dangerous Sudo Binary allowed: less (file-read)
policy_findings.description:
The user(s) [ops] can run '/usr/bin/less /var/log/syslog' via sudo as [root] without a password (NOPASSWD) with the 'file-read' capability. This enables immediate privilege escalation.
GTFObins Context: Inherits file-read behavior from vi.
This can be used to read another file, e.g., when invoked as a pager with some fixed content.
This can be used to read another file.
policy_findings.remediation: Remove this binary from sudoers or replace it with a tightly scoped wrapper script.
policy_findings.remediation_code:
# Replace direct 'less' (file-read) access with a root-owned wrapper script (EXEC: required when global Defaults noexec is active):
ops ALL = (root) PASSWD: EXEC: sha256:<digest> /usr/local/sbin/safe-less-wrapper.sh ""

policy_findings.title: Passwordless Dangerous Sudo Binary allowed: less (shell)
policy_findings.description:
The user(s) [ops] can run '/usr/bin/less /var/log/syslog' via sudo as [root] without a password (NOPASSWD) with the 'shell' capability. This enables immediate privilege escalation.
GTFObins Context: Inherits shell behavior from vi.
The optional 'reset' command is needed to receive the echo back of the typed keystrokes.
policy_findings.remediation: Remove this binary from sudoers or replace it with a tightly scoped wrapper script.
policy_findings.remediation_code:
# Enforce NOEXEC and explicit arguments, or replace with a dedicated wrapper script:
ops ALL = (root) PASSWD: NOEXEC: /usr/bin/less /var/log/syslog
policy_findings.exploit_poc:
less /etc/hosts
!/bin/sh

LESSOPEN="/bin/sh -s 1>&0 2>&0 # %s" less /etc/hosts
reset

VISUAL='/bin/sh -s --' less /etc/hosts
v

# Via vi (trigger with less):
less /etc/hosts
v
# From vi:
vi -c ':!/bin/sh' /dev/null

# Via vi (trigger with less):
less /etc/hosts
v
# From vi:
vi -c ':shell'

# Via vi (trigger with less):
less /etc/hosts
v
# From vi:
vi -c ':set shell=/bin/sh | shell'

# Via vi (trigger with less):
less /etc/hosts
v
# From vi:
vi -c :terminal /bin/sh

policy_findings.title: Passwordless Dangerous Sudo Binary allowed: cat (file-read)
policy_findings.description: The user(s) [ops] can run '/usr/bin/cat /var/log/*' via sudo as [root] without a password (NOPASSWD) with the 'file-read' capability. This enables immediate privilege escalation.
policy_findings.remediation: Remove this binary from sudoers or replace it with a tightly scoped wrapper script.
policy_findings.remediation_code:
# Replace direct 'cat' (file-read) access with a root-owned wrapper script (EXEC: required when global Defaults noexec is active):
ops ALL = (root) PASSWD: EXEC: sha256:<digest> /usr/local/sbin/safe-cat-wrapper.sh ""

policy_findings.title: Wildcard in Command Definition
policy_findings.description: The command '/usr/bin/cat /var/log/*' allowed for user(s) [ops] contains wildcards. Arguments matching wildcards in sudoers can often be bypassed using directory traversals (e.g. '/var/log/../../etc/shadow') or option injection.
policy_findings.remediation: Avoid wildcards in command paths. Use specific paths or write wrapper scripts that validate inputs before executing commands.

policy_findings.title: Passwordless Specific Command Execution Allowed (NOPASSWD)
policy_findings.description: The user(s) [backup] are permitted to run the specific command '/usr/local/sbin/backup.sh ""' as [root] without entering a password (NOPASSWD). While restricted to this binary, any command running passwordless expands the local attack surface if it has argument parsing or script vulnerabilities.
policy_findings.remediation: Ensure that passwordless privileges are strictly necessary. If possible, require authentication or implement strict input validation inside target wrapper scripts.
